csv_project_name: Developer for City-Owned Single-Family Residential Lot
csv_scope_of_work: City of Valentine, Nebraska is soliciting proposals from qualified developers for the development of the city-owned property located at 117 and 121 N. Wood Street. The City envisions a high-quality residential development that enhances the surrounding neighborhood. This RFP is intentionally open-ended regarding the housing type; proponents are encouraged to propose single-family homes, duplexes, or small-scale multi-family/apartment projects that align with their market expertise, community goals, and available density, provided they align with the zoning constraint
